stem.text: One molecule of haemoglobin, $\text{Hb}$, can bind with four molecules of oxygen according to the equation shown.
When the equilibrium concentration of $\text{O}_2$ is $7.6 \times 10^{-6}\,\text{mol dm}^{-3}$, the equilibrium concentrations of $\text{Hb}$ and $\text{Hb(O}_2\text{)}_4$ are equal.
What is the numerical value of $K_\text{c}$ for this equilibrium?
